label: 3rd input token r/t after a z-initial or z/l-second prefix
explanation: Fires only at step t=2 (third original token), never at other steps, the delimiter or the copy phase. Every activation has in_tok in {r (64% of mass), t (25%), y (11%)}, but t==2 with r/t/y alone has only 4% precision, so firing depends on the first two tokens. It is strongest when the first token is z (53% of mass; top examples are z z r and z 0 r) or the second token is z or l. Activation magnitude is tiny (max 0.006 above threshold), so it behaves like a sparse lookup on specific 3-token prefixes. Misses include t after z w/z c/z h, and r after b c or l 0. False positives include r after g z, x l, z p and similar. Adding y raises mass recall to 0.88 but lowers F1.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: t=2 & in_tok=t (+5.75), t=2 & in_tok=y (+4.41), t=2 & prev_tok=l (+4.09), t=2 & prev_tok=z (+4.06), t=2 & in_tok=r (+3.09), prev2_tok=z (+3.01). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-1.80), orig1=t (-1.50), prev_tok=1 (-1.44), orig1=1 (-1.44).
